title: fix(release): refuse a Version Packages PR whose queue build lands behind main; mark next.2's 11 missed changesets
body:
Fixes #23818

Clause-②: no

## What this PR does

Each Version Packages cut now records, by itself, what the previous cut shipped without a CHANGELOG entry. It never refuses or holds a release.

- **New mode `annotate-shipped`** in `scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs`.
  - It finds the last version commit and the changesets that sat unconsumed in its tree.
  - Each one still pending gets this lead line:

    `**Shipped in VERSION**, whose CHANGELOG missed this entry; listed here one prerelease late.`

  - `changeset version` then renders that line as the entry's first line under the next version.
- **One `package.json` line.** The root `version` script runs the step first, joined with `;` so it cannot stop the version pass:

  `node scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs annotate-shipped; changeset version && ...`

  Every caller of `pnpm run version` gets it with no workflow edit.
- **The merge-queue refusal is withdrawn.** The `queue-guard` mode, its batteries and the `lint.yml` step are gone, and `lint.yml` has no diff against `main`. This PR is not governed: `check-governed-merges --branch` reads 0 of 2 paths.
- **The 11 next.2 entries already landed in #23835** (`3c080a65c`). This branch merged `main`, so its diff is 2 files: `package.json` (+1 / -1) and the script (+501 / -26). That is 529 changed lines.

## Root cause: why #21373's guard did not catch next.2

#21373 added `release-pending-publish.mjs unconsumed`. `release.yml`'s `release-integrity` job runs it in the push that carries the version commit.
- It lists every top-level `.changeset/*.md` in that commit's tree that `pre.json` does not record as consumed.
- It reports them as a `::warning::` and a job-summary section.
- Its contract: "The report never refuses a release."

On next.2 it measured correctly. Run 38841989023 (the push of `e5136ff10f`, 02:44Z) carried the warning `11 changeset(s) from 10 commit(s) are still in the tree of the version commit e5136ff10f ...`. The publish job started at 02:47:48Z. The miss was about timing, not pre mode:
- **It reads after the landing.** By then the CHANGELOG files are sealed into the version commit the publish ships. It only warns, and nothing acts on the warning.
- **Pre mode played no part.** @changesets/cli v3 moves what a prerelease pass consumes into `.changeset/pre/`, and `pre.json` lists no ids, so the top-level read is right in pre mode.

The card's premises, checked in a full-history clone:
- **Ancestry.** Each of the 11 add commits is an ancestor of `e5136ff10f` (exit 0) and not of the PR's base `4fe8b3def0` (exit 1). Control leg: root against `4fe8b3def0` gives exit 0.
- **Not consumed.** None of the 11 is under `.changeset/pre/` at `e5136ff10f`.
- **No CHANGELOG entry.** No `## 18.0.0-next.2` section names any of them.

## Why not refuse the landing

The maintainer asked, verbatim: 「23833 做的对吗？发版本的时候 main 上的队列就是不停在合并的」

The seat measured it (record `6211287288` on this PR):
- In the 24 h to 2026-10-16T08:00Z, `main` took 111 first-parent landings, and 77 of them added a changeset: about 3.2 an hour, with at least one in every hour.
- Queue time runs 18 to 33 minutes.
- So a refreshed Version Packages PR would get through a refusing guard about one time in ten, and the guard would turn a mis-dated CHANGELOG line into a release blocker.

The detection was right; refusing was the wrong remedy. This PR keeps the detection and moves the remedy to the next cut.

## The annotate step

1. **Find the last version commit** on HEAD's first-parent chain, by `select`'s definition: the CLI version differs from the first parent's.
2. **Take the changesets left unconsumed there**, the same set `unconsumed` reports. They are read from that commit's tree alone (`pendingChangesetsAt`, which `unconsumed` now shares), so the step needs history only back to that commit's parent.
3. **Annotate each one still pending.** The lead line goes right after the frontmatter, and every other byte is unchanged.
   - It is idempotent: a body whose first line already starts with `**Shipped in` is left as it is. That covers a second run and the hand-written lines from #23835. The step's text differs from #23835's only by #23835's card number.
   - It annotates only when VERSION is on npm. A version commit nobody published shipped nothing, and its changesets then land in the next CHANGELOG correctly.
   - The line says "release" instead of "prerelease" for a version with no prerelease tag.
4. **It never blocks.**
   - The mode exits 0 on every path, and the `;` keeps even a crash from stopping `changeset version`.
   - When it cannot decide, it prints a `::warning::` and writes nothing. That covers no version commit, unreachable history, an unreadable tree or `pre.json`, and npm unreadable.
   - A changeset it cannot parse is skipped with its own warning.
5. **A shallow clone deepens itself, with bounds.** It runs `git fetch --no-tags --deepen=N origin HEAD-SHA` with N = 100, 200, 400, 800, 1600, until the version commit and its parent are both present. It stops early, with a warning, when a round gains nothing. `--no-deepen` turns the fetch off.

## Proof

**Self-test.** `node scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs --self-test` passes 112 cases across 28 batteries. The six annotate batteries:
- **the next.2 shape** (v3 pre-mode layout): exactly the 3 late changesets are annotated, with byte-exact output. A changeset added after the version commit and one consumed into `pre/` are untouched. A CRLF changeset keeps its line endings, and a changeset with no fence is unparseable;
- **a second run** writes nothing, and every file stays byte-identical;
- **a hand-annotated changeset** (#23835's form, card number included) is left byte-identical, and the other two are annotated once each, read from disk;
- **non-pre mode** (17.6.0 -> 17.7.0) uses the "release" form;
- **a depth-1 clone** deepens itself and annotates the same three, read from disk. With `origin` unreachable it warns, writes nothing, and the CLI exits 0. With `--no-deepen` it is undecided;
- **the no-decision cases**: no CLI manifest; a manifest born in the root commit; a manifest created later; a version not on npm (a plain line); npm unreadable; a run outside any git repository (the CLI exits 0 with a warning); an unreadable `pre.json`. Nothing is written in any of them.

**Ablation.** `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the write `writeFileSync(w.abs, w.next);` with `void w.next;` (anchor 1 -> 0, blob `4bfd5209005c` -> `9566045703cc`). The self-test went red on 5 cases: byte-exact, second run, hand-annotated, non-pre, depth-1. Restore: the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

**Real history.** The script is this branch's. Each clone below was made the way `actions/checkout` makes the version-pr job's (depth 1, sha-pinned) unless stated otherwise.

| tree | result |
|---|---|
| `origin/main` `3fed1eb00`, before #23835 landed | deepened by 100 commits in 6.9 s; last version commit `e5136ff10f` (next.1 -> next.2); **exactly the 11 annotated**; exit 0 |
| same tree, second run | 0 annotated, 11 already; tree byte-identical to the first run's |
| the same 11 compared with #23835's blobs | each differs only in that one line, by the ` (#23818)` card number |
| #23835's head `af52476f3` | 0 annotated, 11 already; nothing written |
| `3c080a65c` (#23835 landed; the base of the seat's 08:45Z re-cut of #23825, run 38875444505) | 0 annotated, 11 already; nothing written |
| the re-cut #23825 head `dedc6fe388` | last version commit is the re-cut itself (next.3, not on npm), so "nothing shipped without an entry"; nothing written |

**The CHANGELOG renders the line once.**
- **Full `pnpm run version`**, in a full-history clone of `origin/main` `3fed1eb00` with this branch's script and `version` line committed locally (never pushed): exit 0 in 14.5 s. The step annotated the 11, and next.3 carries the line on 19 entries across 12 packages, none twice.
- **The seat's re-cut** `dedc6fe388` (built from #23835's hand lines): 19 entries carry the line, none twice.

## Every caller of `pnpm run version`, measured

| caller | checkout | what the step does there | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `release.yml` version-pr job, render step | depth 1 (default) | deepens the clone itself, then annotates | the depth-1 clone above (+100 commits, 6.9 s, exit 0). Moved paths with the step: 230; without (the old script on the same tree): 230, identical sets, so the SHAPE validation sees nothing new. All 10 content gates that step runs exit 0 on the annotated tree: `check:docs-image-tag`, `check:docs-image-tag-sync`, `check:template-version-sync`, `check:release-index-currency-sync`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:release-notes`, `check:release-page-status`, `check-release-section-coverage.mjs`, `check:published-readme-links` |
| `release.yml` restore step, then `changesets/action` `version-script` (same job) | the deepened clone, after `git reset --hard` | annotates again on the fresh tree, with no second fetch; this is the tree the PR commits | the restore step's `git checkout -- .` puts the annotated files back with everything else; the 230-path set above is unchanged |
| `cut-rc.yml` | `fetch-depth: 0` | no fetch; annotates | its changeset gates run before `pnpm run version`; afterwards it stages `.changeset` wholesale, so the annotated files move to `pre/` with the rest |
| local rehearsal (`docs/releases-maintenance.md`) | a clone of the shared checkout | exit 0, wrote only `.changeset/` files | measured: it found next.1's version commit and annotated next.1's 6 leaked changesets (see Acceptance notes) |

## What to do about #23825 (next.3) now

#23825 was re-cut at 08:45Z from `3c080a65c`, so it carries the 11 entries correctly. `main` has moved since (`66d456d01`, #23840), so as cut it is behind again.

**Land this PR before the next.4 cut, then merge #23825 whenever the maintainer chooses.** Whatever #23825 ships unlisted when it lands, the next cut annotates as "Shipped in 18.0.0-next.3". Nothing needs freezing or refreshing at merge time.

## Acceptance notes

None of these is filed. The seat decides at landing.
- **next.1 leaked too.** Version commit `0c52e43075` (#23382) left 6 changesets unconsumed: `23268-external-sharing-model-retired`, `23268-skills-lint-rules-row`, `23357-page-component-view-data-api-refused`, `23387-two-master-names-release`, `23397-ceremony-builtin-positions`, `23399-ceremony-not-declared-column-drop`. They shipped in next.1 and are listed in the published next.2 sections with no note: 0 next.1-section hits for each add commit. This is the same family as this card. This step covers every cut from here on; a published entry is corrected only by a docs-only amendment.
- **The GA CHANGELOG will repeat the note.** At `pre exit`, the GA CHANGELOG re-lists every prerelease changeset, so an annotated one carries "listed here one prerelease late" into the GA section too. The #23835 lines do the same.
- **The ADR-0087 pass line.** `check-adr-0087-registration`'s pass line counts inherited-breaking changesets as "non-breaking". Its inheritance exemption also does not re-ask an edited, already-breaking changeset for its disposition. This is read off the code.
- **The post-landing warning's remedy.** `unconsumed`'s post-landing warning still says "Name them in the VERSION release notes". With this step, the next cut does that.

## Local gates (final head `1cdd9d114`, merge base `66d456d01`)

- **Derivation.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 38 families. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe. **All 38 exit 0.** These include:
  - `release-pending-publish.mjs --self-test`;
  - `check-self-test-wired` and `check-self-test-workflow-commands`;
  - `check:merge-driver` and `check:turbo-task-graph`;
  - `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, after a closure build under the verify lock (74/74 tasks, `VERDICT command-exit 0`);
  - `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier).
- **Reconciliation:** `--ran` reports 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- **Lint:** `eslint --no-inline-config scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs` exits 0.
- **Governance:** `check-governed-merges --branch` reports 0 of 2 paths governed, 529 changed lines (+502 / -27). `lint.yml` has no diff against `origin/main`.
